judgments.justification: “higher top-1 accuracy...a statistically significant mean paired difference of 1.7 points” correctly reports the clean paired advantage.
“robust...at all evaluated quality settings” with drops “all within” 2.0 correctly covers JPEG qualities 90 through 10.
It does not report Ferncastle-CNN’s criterion status at qualities 90–70 or its failures at 50–10.
“1.8 vs 9.8 points at quality 10” correctly contrasts both models’ drops under the most severe JPEG compression.
It provides no limitation concerning one test split, five JPEG settings, or missing JPEG inferential tests and uncertainty intervals.
“exceeds...at the strongest blur” understates the scope: Loamwise-ViT also exceeded the criterion at 7-pixel blur.
“all within the...2.0-point” criterion and “1.8...at quality 10” correctly report robustness across every JPEG setting.
Although it gives Ferncastle-CNN’s 9.8-point drop at quality 10, it does not report criterion exceedance at quality 50 and below.
